raw_response:
Alright, let me think this through the way I always do — field by field, what I did last year, what the money allows.

---

I've been working this land for 15 years, so I know more or less what cotton needs in our soil. Of my 16.9 mu, I keep the bigger piece — about 12 mu — in cotton, same as most households in the village. The other 5 mu or so I put in maize. That's been my pattern for a while now and it works for us.

**Cotton first.** I plant around late April, maybe the 20th if the ground is warm enough. Same seed as last year, the kind they sell at the co-op shop — I don't trust those fancy new varieties, my neighbor Old Wang tried one two years ago and it wasn't any better than what I use. Costs about 40 yuan per mu for seed.

For fertilizer I put down one bag of compound (50 kg) per mu before I plant — that gives me maybe 7 or 8 kg of N. Then when the cotton starts to flower, around July, I topdress with urea, about one scoop per plant row, works out to 10-12 kg urea per mu. Altogether maybe 13 kg of N per mu. The extension fellow said once I should add more, but I can't afford it every year — my two boys are still in school and I need cash in reserve. If the cotton looks yellow I might sneak in a bit more urea, we'll see.

Water — I pull from the well twice. Once right after planting if the soil is dry, once at flowering in July. Pumping electricity isn't free so I don't do more unless it's really dry. If June rains come good I skip the first one.

Bollworm is the big worry. I spray insecticide 3, maybe 4 times through summer. Herbicide once right after planting before cotton emerges. Don't usually need fungicide.

Picking cotton is the hard part. Me and my wife do most of it from September through October — three pickings. If we fall behind I pay someone for a few days. Last year I got about 230 kg of lint per mu. This year if weather is normal I hope for the same, maybe a bit better.

**For the maize**, about 5 mu. Summer maize, planted around June 15th. Hybrid seed, 50 yuan per mu — with maize the hybrid is worth it, everyone uses it now. Before planting one bag of compound, then at knee-high stage I topdress urea, maybe 15 kg per mu. Total N around 14 kg per mu. Water once if rain is short. Herbicide after planting and that's usually all. Harvest end of September. Normal year I get maybe 450 kg per mu.

Most of the work is me and my wife. Oldest boy helps on weekends when he isn't working in town. For picking I'll hire a couple of days.

Cash-wise, cotton is more expensive — probably 800 yuan per mu in inputs. Maize maybe 400. I need to keep some money back in case the pump breaks or a kid gets sick.
